items.title: Albert "Fernandez" Walters Interview, 1959-01-05
items.q: I think Georgia Lutz was playing with Kit Howard then.

ctx.x: And clarinet, did you have a clarinet or sax? No they had a clarinet,
I think Georgia Lutz was playing with Kit Howard then.
And let's see, who else would be in the band? Drums and banjo I guess maybe.
